entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to ask about a return. I have my order number if you need it.
Of course, I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Yes, it's VF886-04. I just feel so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I saved up for this.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you being a long-time VeloFit customer. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see you purchased the Pro-Weave Jersey. I'm also showing it was delivered 53 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's just the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is just... so incredibly tight. I was really looking forward to wearing it, but it just doesn't fit at all. I feel a bit silly for waiting so long to call.
I see. So it's not a tear or a manufacturing fault, but an issue with the fit? You feel it's too tight?
Yes, exactly. It's way too tight. I was hoping I could maybe get an exchange or something? I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out, you know?

I can definitely check the options for you. One moment while I review the policy for this item... Okay, good news. The jersey falls under our standard 90-day return window. Since you received it 53 days ago, you're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So... I can return it?
Absolutely. We can process a return for a full refund, or if you'd prefer, I can set up an exchange for a larger size. Whichever works best for you.
Oh, thank you so much! That's such a huge relief. Let's just do the return for a refund, if that's okay. Thank you, Isaac. You've really helped me out today.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I have just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
